faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Clear answers about our planning process, pricing, and how consultations work.

items.q: Why do you charge for an initial consultation?
items.a: Unlike brokers who offer free quotes to push venues that pay them secret commissions, we work strictly for you with zero vendor markups. In our paid session, we give you unbiased advice on true venue costs, electricity surcharges, and sound curfew rules. Plus, 100% of your consultation fee is credited back if you book our full planning service.

items.q: Do I need to have a venue booked before talking to you?
items.a: Not at all. In fact, consulting with us before signing a hotel contract is the best way to save money and avoid costly penalty clauses. We help you compare venues and understand all hidden costs upfront.

items.q: What happens during the consultation call?
items.a: We jump on a private 1-on-1 video call to review your dates, guest count, and vision. We give you a realistic budget breakdown, share suitable venue recommendations, and send you a summary plan with hotel contacts after the call.
You can easily reschedule your consultation anytime up to 24 hours before the call at no additional cost. Just message or email us.

items.q: Are calls held online or can we meet in person?
items.a: We conduct video calls over Google Meet for couples across India and abroad. If you are in Jaipur, you are also welcome to meet our team in person at our Mahima Trinity Mall office in Sodala.
